evidence.note: finalWireName is computed only from normalized (truncate-plus-digest or the full normalized string), so any duplicate normalized key is also a duplicate finalWireName; hasNormalizedDuplicates therefore implies hasFinalDuplicates.

The report writer binds both flags from one candidate list and treats normalized collision as the stronger failure; (true,false) is never produced because the final-name grouping cannot be empty when the normalized grouping is not.

notes: Corrects the prior D1. Legal states are clean, final-only collision after truncation, and normalized collision (which always includes a final collision). Combined-true remains legal; the missing state is normalized-true/final-false.
